description_en: Invokes ListClasses to retrieve a list of classes. You can perform a paged query of all classes for an application by application ID and class status
description_zh: 调用ListClasses获取课程列表。可基于应用ID和课程状态，分页查询应用对应的所有课程列表
name: ListClasses

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the application, which consists of 6 lowercase letters and digits
parameters.help_zh: 应用唯一标识，由6位小写字母、数字组成
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The class status.

0: not started 
1: in progress 
2: ended
If this parameter is not specified, all classes are returned
parameters.help_zh:
课程状态

0-未开课 
1-上课中 
2-已下课
不传则返回所有课程
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. If this parameter is left empty, the first page is queried by default
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，从1开始，传空默认查询第1页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示个数，最大支持50，参数为空默认显示个数为10
parameters.name: page_size

Result.description_en: The result returned for the class list query
Result.description_zh: 查询课程列表返回的结果

ClassId.description_en: The unique identifier of the class
ClassId.title_en: 课堂唯一标识，由调用CreateClass返回。
ClassId.title_zh: 课堂唯一标识，由调用CreateClass返回。

ConfId.description_en: The co-streaming conference ID. You can use this ID to join an RTC conference and retrieve conference details
ConfId.description_zh: 连麦会议ID。可用于RTC入会，获取会议详情

CreateNickname.description_en: The nickname of the creator. Chinese and English characters are supported. Maximum length: 32 characters
CreateNickname.description_zh: 创建人用户昵称，支持中英文，最大长度32个字符

CreateUserId.description_en: The user ID of the creator. Only English characters and digits are supported. Maximum length: 36 characters
CreateUserId.description_zh: 创建人用户ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36个字符

EndTime.description_en: The timestamp when the class ended, in milliseconds

LiveId.description_en: The live stream ID. You can use this ID to query live stream details and pass it as a parameter when calling live stream-related operations on the client
LiveId.description_zh: 直播ID。可用于查询直播详情，和端上调用直播相关接口时作为参数传入

RoomId.description_en: The room ID. You can use this ID to query room details and pass it as a parameter when integrating with the client SDK
RoomId.description_zh: 房间ID。可用于查询房间详情信息，和端上SDK接入时作为参数传入

StartTime.description_en: The timestamp when the class started, in milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 开始上课时间戳，单位：毫秒

Status.description_en:
The class status.

0: not started 
1: in progress 
2: ended
Status.description_zh:
课堂状态

0:未开始 
1:上课中 
2:已下课
Status.title_en: 课堂状态，0:未开始 1:上课中 2:已下课。
Status.title_zh: 课堂状态，0:未开始 1:上课中 2:已下课。

Title.description_en: The class title. Chinese and English characters are supported. Maximum length: 32 characters
Title.description_zh: 课程标题，支持中英文，最大长度32个字符

WhiteboardId.description_en: The whiteboard ID. You can use this ID to query whiteboard information and pass it as a parameter when integrating with the whiteboard SDK on the client
WhiteboardId.description_zh: 白板ID。可用于查询白板信息，和端上接入白板SDK时作为参数传入

WhiteboardRecordId.description_en: The whiteboard recording ID. You can use this ID to retrieve and play back whiteboard recording content on the client
WhiteboardRecordId.description_zh: 白板录制ID。可用于端上获取白板录制内容并播放

HasMore.description_en: Indicates whether there are more pages
